proofs.text: Write one marked file per framework (`test_a.py`, `a.test.js`, `a.test.ts`, `A.cs`, `a.test.sh`, `test_a.sql`) and scan each framework; verify every scan returns exactly `{("feat", "PROOF-1")}`. Put a marked file under `node_modules/`; verify the jest scan returns an empty set

rule_text: The marker scan reads the marker of each of the six shipped frameworks out of that framework's own file extensions, and never descends into `node_modules`, `bin`, `obj` or a dotted directory

tests.name: test_node_modules_is_not_scanned
